title.vi: Đạo luật miễn giảm lãi suất, tiền phạt và phụ phí đối với thuế di sản và thừa kế phải nộp bởi di sản của cựu chiến binh, du kích hoặc nạn nhân tội ác man rợ của Nhật Bản đã qua đời trong thời kỳ chiếm đóng của Nhật Bản, với một số điều kiện nhất định và vì các mục đích khác
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติยกเว้นการชำระดอกเบี้ย ค่าปรับ และค่าธรรมเนียมเพิ่มเติมสำหรับภาษีมรดกและภาษีมรดกที่ต้องชำระจากมรดกของทหารผ่านศึก สมาชิกกองกำลังกบฏ หรือเหยื่อความโหดร้ายของญี่ปุ่นที่เสียชีวิตระหว่างการยึดครองของญี่ปุ่น โดยมีเงื่อนไขบางประการและเพื่อวัตถุประสงค์อื่น
title.id: Undang-Undang tentang Penghapusan Pembayaran Bunga, Denda, dan Biaya Tambahan atas Pajak Warisan dan Pajak Pewarisan yang Terutang dari Harta Warisan Veteran, Gerilyawan, atau Korban Kebiadaban Jepang yang Meninggal Selama Pendudukan Jepang dengan Syarat-Syarat Tertentu dan untuk Tujuan Lain

text.en: The provisions of the National Internal Revenue Code to the contrary notwithstanding, the collection of interest, and/or penalties and surcharges due on inheritance and estate taxes from the estate of veterans, guerrillas or victims of Japanese atrocities who died during the Japanese occupation, from the time such interest, and or penalties and surcharges accrued up to actual payment, is hereby waived: Provided, However , That the basic tax is paid on or before December 31, 1955.
Taxes remaining unpaid after said date shall not be covered by the provisions of this Act.

Payments already made in the concept of interest, and/or penalties and surcharges due on account of such inheritance and estate taxes shall not be reimbursed but shall be applied to the payment of the basic tax.
Nothing in this Act shall be construed to mean the condonation of any tax of whatever nature.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 10, 1955.
